// SYNTAX TEST "source.ds"

// types / representation / repr and layout attributes
@repr("C")
// <- entity.name.function.decorator.ds
struct Header {
// <- keyword.declaration.type.ds
    tag: uint8;
    size: uint32;
}

@repr("transparent")
// <- entity.name.function.decorator.ds
newtype FileDescriptor = int32;
// <- keyword.declaration.type.ds

@repr(uint8)
// <- entity.name.function.decorator.ds
enum Color {
// <- keyword.declaration.type.ds
    Red = 1,
    Green = 2,
}

@repr({ align: 64 })
// <- entity.name.function.decorator.ds
@repr({ packed: true })
// <- entity.name.function.decorator.ds
struct WireHeader {
    tag: uint8;
    size: uint32;
}

// types / representation / layout intrinsics
const size = comptime sizeOf<Header>();
//           ^^^^^^^^ keyword.other.comptime.ds
//                    ^^^^^^ entity.name.function.call.ds

const alignment = comptime alignOf<Header>();
//                         ^^^^^^^ entity.name.function.call.ds

const stride = comptime strideOf<Header>();
//                      ^^^^^^^^ entity.name.function.call.ds

const layout = comptime layoutOf<Header>();
//                      ^^^^^^^^ entity.name.function.call.ds

declare let bytes: [uint8; sizeOf<Header>()];

type Slots<T, comptime N: usize = strideOf<T>()> = [uint8; N];

declare let erased: Any<Writer>;
//                  ^^^ entity.name.type.ds
